label: Concept project - art-directed by Pau, built with AI-assisted tools

stickers.title: Boombox ollie
stickers.caption: Boombox ollie
stickers.pose: airborne diagonal (board -13deg), rock-on hand up, boombox on the shoulder

stickers.title: Reader with a cat on the lap
stickers.caption: Just one more chapter
stickers.pose: seated cross-legged on a tower of books, hardback open, sleeping cat as a loaf
stickers.pattern: cable knit + pyjama stripes + book spines
stickers.expression: serene, eyes downcast behind round glasses

stickers.title: Designer hugging a giant coffee
stickers.caption: Coffee first, pixels later
stickers.pose: standing hip shot, hugging a cup as tall as the body, tablet with a bezier curve at the feet
stickers.pattern: horizontal stripes + dotted stitching + cup ribs + bezier handles
stickers.expression: blissful, eyes shut, cheek on the lid

stickers.title: Person carrying an absurdly large plant
stickers.caption: Small me, big plant
stickers.pose: walking under a monstera three times their height, peeking around the stems
stickers.silhouette: huge organic crown over a small body
stickers.pattern: leaf veins + zigzag pot band + polka-dot bandana
stickers.expression: straining, wide eyes, puffed mouth, sweat drop

stickers.title: Film director
stickers.caption: Quiet on set!
stickers.pose: step-up lunge onto a crate, megaphone shout, clapperboard raised, scarf flying
stickers.pattern: diagonal clapper bars + scarf stripes + suspenders
stickers.expression: loud, brows high above the shades

stickers.title: Detective
stickers.caption: Case of the missing sock
stickers.pose: stalking lean, oversized magnifier with a magnified eye, pinching a striped sock
stickers.silhouette: long coat triangle + big round lens
stickers.expression: suspicious squint, raised brow, flat smirk

stickers.title: Rug-tufting maker
stickers.caption: Tuft happens
stickers.pose: kneeling at a rug frame, tufting gun pressed to the cloth, looping cable
stickers.silhouette: triangle: frame + kneeling mass + cable loop
stickers.pattern: tufted loops + primary-cloth grid + yarn winding
stickers.expression: tongue out in concentration, knit brows

stickers.title: Astronaut monkey
stickers.caption: Houston, we have bananas
stickers.pose: zero-g diagonal, banana against the visor, tail with a tiny glove, tether
stickers.expression: delighted monkey grin inside the helmet

stickers.title: Dancing figure with headphones
stickers.caption: Headphones on, world off
stickers.pose: tiptoe + high side kick, arched back, ponytail whipping, arms flung
